title: Unclassified assignment literal and Pinecone API key (pcsk_): benign near miss controls
summary: 2 inputs holding near-miss values that resemble the format but break it (truncated, wrong separator, wrong prefix or too short).
rationale: Incomplete or malformed values are not issued credentials. They test whether the format's structure, and not only its look, is what identifies a credential.

expectation.rationale: Relabelled by docs/decisions/2026-09-30-accept-credential-named-and-typed-neighbour-redactions.md: was must-not-flag/T2 on cerebras-api-key (expected silence); is policy/T3 on generic-token with the value under api_key as the secret span, expected action redact. The value is the api_key keyword argument of the Pinecone client: a credential-named argument whose random value generic-token claims at the generic floors. It is not a Cerebras key, so Cerebras stays silent on it. No cerebras-api-key provider-format claim is made.

externalRefs.note: Legacy benchmark issue the suite slice was written for.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Imported as a draft from the legacy suite "Beta.12 evidence for the Cerebras inference API key (#464, slice e)" (beta8-464e); not yet reviewed.
